items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was just the tuner that Paul [inaudible] used to tune the pianos.

ctx.x: The son of that pianist. I’ve got his name written down, because I always forgot. His father’s name was a hard name for me to remember. He tuned my piano before a concert, the son, and he said . . .
We didn’t know who he was. He was just the tuner that Paul [inaudible] used to tune the pianos.
